svg.title: Virtual WAN secured-hub profile and optional hybrid branch
svg.desc: Spoke1 and Spoke2 connect to a managed hub. Routing intent directs matching private and Internet traffic through Azure Firewall. An optional Azure-hosted branch reaches the hub through VPN gateways. Route Server is absent from this Spoke1.
